LCII.reason: Pending Patrick merger: fixed 1.2440 PATK shares per LCII share changes the standalone investment thesis. DOJ second request adds execution risk.
LCII.release_condition: Verify current transaction status and assess combined-company value, exchange ratio, regulatory conditions and downside if the deal fails before using an ordinary-company valuation.

LRN.reason: September-quarter results were published October 20; June-only financial evidence misses the latest results. Review the September 2027 convertible maturity and dilution as well.
LRN.release_condition: Reconcile September statements, including $418.431m current debt carrying value and $85.463m current finance leases, with unrestricted funding. Verify the $420m contractual note principal due September 1, 2027 and conversion/capped-call effects; assess enrollment recovery. A provider refresh alone does not resolve the hold.

review_notes.finding: September balances show $418.431m current debt carrying value and $85.463m current finance leases. The earlier June current-debt proxy therefore misses material near-term obligations; carrying value is not contractual principal.

Convertible principal is settled in cash; conversion premiums can use cash or shares. Capped-call protection has an upper strike of $86.174, so generic 5% dilution is not sufficient underwriting for a doubling case.

The September 30 10-Q confirms $420m principal remains outstanding, all $418.431m carrying value is current, and maturity is September 1, 2027. Its fiscal-2028 maturity label does not mean calendar 2028. Initial conversion is 18.9109 shares per $1,000; premium settlement and capped calls still need a company-specific cash/share model.

PNR.reason: Taco acquisition closed October 1 after the June financial period used by the scanner; acquisition funding and pro forma liquidity require reconciliation before using historical leverage or recovery sensitivities.
PNR.release_condition: The October 27 filing resolves the actual Taco loan draw. Reconcile post-close cash, acquired obligations, recurring cash generation, contractual payments through the next 24 months and actual covenant headroom. Assess integration and Pool recovery before using a combined-company valuation. A September 30 balance sheet alone still predates closing.

review_notes.finding: Pentair reports completion of the Taco acquisition for approximately $1.4bn, subject to adjustments, on October 1. The scan's June debt/cash snapshot predates the completed transaction.

September financing provides $400m due 18 months after acquisition closing and $1bn due May 5, 2030. Full drawing was intended, but no loans were outstanding on September 1; actual funding/refinancing remains to be reconciled. If the first tranche was funded at the October 1 close, its stated term points to April 2028, within the 24-month review horizon.

The financing summary sets leverage at most 3.75x, conditionally 4.25x for material acquisitions, and EBITDA/cash-interest at least 3.00x under contractual definitions. Reported pre-acquisition provider ratios are not current covenant headroom.
The September 22 filing appoints Robert W. Hau as CFO effective November 1. It does not provide the post-acquisition funding reconciliation needed to clear this hold.

The October 27 filing confirms the full $1.4bn Taco loan draw on October 1, including $400m due April 1, 2028. Funding execution is resolved; reconciled post-close liquidity and covenant headroom remain pending.

SFD.reason: September 8 profit warning: Fresh Pork margin compression and lower hog prices undermine an unchanged historical cash-flow assumption.
SFD.release_condition: Reconcile next results and outlook with normalized cash flow, capital spending and debt liquidity. Verify drawing/redemption of the October facility and covenant headroom; source evidence for operating recovery rather than assuming commodity weakness is temporary.

review_notes.finding: A $600m conditional delayed-draw facility is available through December 23, 2026 and matures three years after funding. Intended 2027-note redemption is a plan, not completed repayment; proceeds must not also be counted as extra cash.
The facility requires debt/capital at most 50% (55% for specified acquisitions) and defined EBITDA/interest coverage at least 3.5x. Actual headroom and operating recovery remain unresolved.
